posts.text:
Opus 5 is a great model for coding, data analysis, design, biology, knowledge work.

More than any of these eval scores, what is most exciting to me is something else: Opus 5 is our least prompt injectable model yet. It is a bit buried in the system card, but across PI evals and red teaming, Opus 5 is very hard to prompt inject successfully.

And when layering defenses -- strong model alignment, combined with prompt injection probes, combined with Auto Mode in Claude Code -- the success rate for prompt injection attacks drops to ~0. This is new and exciting! More about this soon.

https://t.co/Tc7z2FqJhQ

expert.why: Claude Code 核心人物之一，代表 AI 编程工作流、工程角色变化、Agentic 软件开发方向

posts.translationZh:
Opus 5 是一款非常适合编程、数据分析、设计、生物学和知识工作的优秀模型。

比这些评测分数更让我兴奋的是另一件事：Opus 5 是我们迄今最难被提示注入的模型。系统卡里对此提得不多，但在各类 PI 评测和红队测试中，Opus 5 很难被成功提示注入。

而当多层防御叠加时——强模型对齐、提示注入探测，以及 Claude Code 中的 Auto Mode 结合起来——提示注入攻击的成功率会降至约 0。这很新，也很令人兴奋！很快会分享更多。

https://t.co/Tc7z2FqJhQ

posts.text: people are still just scratching the surface of how chatgpt work can be used. we want AI to empower people to live better lives, and believe agentic capabilities will be a core part of how it'll happen.

quotedTweet.text:
A billion users can now create and publish websites from their phones with ChatGPT Work. 

But most people don’t really grasp the full extent of the capabilities here. From your phone, you also have access to:

- Cloud computer (15 GB RAM)
- Persistent workspace & files
- Terminal and code execution
- Remote browser
- Connected plugins (Slack, Gmail, GitHub, etc.)
- All your personal finances, transactions, bank statements
- Scheduled tasks
- Git clone & PR creation
- Build & deploy websites
- Create docs, sheets, and slides
- Inbox/calendar summarization
- Website monitoring & alerts

All at your fingertips, using a simple chat interface, no laptop required. 

All you have to do is switch to the Work tab on your ChatGPT app.
quotedTweet.translationZh:
现在，十亿用户都可以通过手机用 ChatGPT Work 创建并发布网站。

但大多数人还没有真正理解这里能力的完整范围。通过手机，你还可以使用：

- 云端计算机（15 GB RAM）
- 持久化工作区和文件
- 终端和代码执行
- 远程浏览器
- 已连接的插件（Slack、Gmail、GitHub 等）

- 创建文档、表格和幻灯片
- 收件箱/日历摘要
- 网站监控和告警

所有这些都触手可及，只需一个简单的聊天界面，不需要笔记本电脑。

你要做的只是切换到 ChatGPT 应用里的 Work 标签页。

posts.text: The commies are out in full force supporting open weights

quotedTweet.text:
NVIDIA, Palantir, Replit, Microsoft, Crowdstrike, Dell and others send a strong message to congress to keep open access to open weights models.

"Our AI leadership will be judged not by one frontier AI model, but whether the United States builds a strong, open ecosystem that diffuses into every sector."

"Open weights also strengthen competition and competition is what keeps the gains of AI broadly shared rather than concentrated in a few hands."

"Openness may be one of the most important paths to AI safety and security."
quotedTweet.translationZh:

posts.text:
We benchmarked Opus 5 comprehensively on document understanding through ParseBench. 

It is roughly on par with Opus 4.8 - it does a few points worse on dense tables, but does slightly better on parsing charts and visual grounding.

For reference, Gemini 3.6 Flash has better results on tables, is slightly worse on charts, and is half the price. LlamaParse agentic is better on all fronts (including tables) at 1/6th of the price. 

tl;dr use Opus 5 as much as you want for coding and knowledge work. But at 8c per page and average OCR performance, don't use it to parse documents at scale 

Our full ParseBench leaderboard which we periodically update is here: https://t.co/PWczfhp0OX

expert.name: Jerry Liu
expert.why: RAG、知识 Agent、企业数据 Agent 的重要实践信号源；排序低于 OpenAI 核心人物

posts.translationZh:
我们通过 ParseBench 对 Opus 5 的文档理解能力做了全面基准测试。

它大致与 Opus 4.8 持平：在密集表格上低了几分，但在图表解析和视觉定位上略好。

作为参考，Gemini 3.6 Flash 在表格上的结果更好，在图表上略差，价格是它的一半。LlamaParse agentic 在所有方面都更好（包括表格），价格只有六分之一。

tl;dr：编码和知识工作可以尽管使用 Opus 5。但每页 8c 且 OCR 表现一般，不要用它进行大规模文档解析。

我们会定期更新的完整 ParseBench 排行榜在这里：https://t.co/PWczfhp0OX
